task.title: Creating an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction for IPOC

step.cmd: Determine if there is a revised registration number for the advance payment reconciliation issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 42.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the BPC is being changed to an earlier period:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 43.
If no, go to step 45.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 50 - Legislative interim measures .
Remarks line 1: Type “$2 000 advance payment OP reconciliation. BPC antedate required.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type the following information:
If a W allocation is on file, type “Rescind W allocation $[XXXX], w/c [XXXX].”
Type “Antedate to BPC [XXXX]. No change to earnings, divisor, hours.”
For each claimant’s report used to recoup the OP, type “Process w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX to offset the ERB2 OP.” If necessary, type “Remove FWW or found work coding in w/c [XXXX].”
Type “No coding” or add any required coding, such as other disentitlements, etc.
Type “Terminate appeal lock on [DD-MM-YYYY]. Apply UP to OP.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first and last name.
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select C - Non Fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 39 - Overpayment established change in commencement date .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 46.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 50 - Legislative interim measures .
Remarks line 1: Type “$2 000 advance payment OP reconciliation.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type the following information:
If a W allocation is on file, type “Rescind W allocation $[XXXX], w/c [XXXX].”
For each claimant’s report used to recoup the OP, type “Process w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX] to offset the ERB2 OP.” If necessary, type “Remove FWW or found work coding in w/c [XXXX].”
Type “No coding” or add any required coding, such as other disentitlements, etc.
Type “Terminate appeal lock on [DD-MM-YYYY]. Apply UP to OP. 21-F-46.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the X-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Insert ADMS Record ID (4059)
Notice of Administrative Review Decision(s) addressed to client - Client Requested Reconsideration (11980)
Date Request for Reconsideration received (4063)
Date of Commission’s decision (4065): Select the date on the initial decision letter.
List of issues (11981)

Decision completely rescinded or removed / maintained / modified or replaced by a new decision (11982): Select the appropriate option:
Decision completely rescinded or removed
Decision modified or replaced by a new decision
Blank / When employer is an interested party (11984)

step.cmd: Determine if the initial decision was rescinded or modified:

ul.li: If the decision was rescinded, go to step 49.
If the decision was modified, go to step 50.

step.cmd: In ADMS, complete the Review Decision screen as follows:

ul.li: Date RFR Decision issued: Enter the date the reconsideration under EIA 112 was finalized. EIA 112
RFR Decision result: Select Decision rescinded .
Reason: Select the appropriate reason why the decision was rescinded.
Date RFR Decision Implemented: Enter the date the decision was implemented.
Date RFR Decision sent to Requestor: Enter the date the letter was sent.
Select Save .
Go to step 51.

step.cmd: In ADMS, complete the Review Decision screen as follows:

ul.li: Date RFR Decision issued: Enter the date the reconsideration under EIA 112 was finalized. EIA 112
RFR Decision Result: Select Decision Maintained with Modifications .
Date RFR Decision implemented: Enter the date the decision was implemented.
Date RFR Decision sent to Requestor: Enter the date the letter was sent.
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if ADMS inputs are complete for all decisions:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 52.
If no, complete the missing fields, then go to step 52.
